summary: EltonTraits (CC0) gives per-species percent foraging stratum for all birds and AVONET gives per-species morphology (CC BY 4.0), so both sides of a habit-versus-structure comparison exist at species level; foot webbing or toe arrangement was not confirmed in either, and temporal order of change is not in any trait table.
